API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementBulk Delete Users
Bulk Delete Users
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/users/bulkDelete

Bulk delete users up to a maximum of 500 users per request. The response returns the user IDs that were successfully deleted.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The user IDs to bulk delete.

ids
int32[]
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
ids
object[]
